mapper.select: SELECT no,subject,q.member_id,name,status,hit,TO_CHAR(q.regdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') as dbday FROM course_qna q JOIN member m ON q.member_id=m.member_id WHERE course_no=#{course_no} ORDER BY no desc OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT no,answer,name,TO_CHAR(r.regdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') as dbday FROM course_qna_reply r JOIN member m ON r.member_id=m.member_id WHERE course_qna_no=#{course_qna_no}
